meta.docTitle: Peerless Fence Group × DataSkate — Integration Discovery
meta.docSubtitle: 8 confirmed flows · HD Portal + Salesforce + ComputerEase + Anypoint IDP · Most answers are pre-filled — please verify and correct
meta.source: Peerless scoping calls Apr 14 / Apr 15 / Apr 17 + MuleSoft Automation Starter SOW

bizContext.snapshot: Ashley described it directly on the Apr 17 call — "So we have no data points or information of what they've done with this customer, if anything, other than that they created a quote but not that they've given the customer a quote." That gap is the engagement. Today HD Portal leads have to be retyped into Salesforce by hand, ComputerEase customer and job entry happens manually one record at a time, signed 299A and 299B contracts are downloaded and re-attached one PDF at a time, and Ashley reconciles by hand across four systems. On go-live day, every one of those steps stops. The path through the legacy ComputerEase environment is cautious — the API runs only against production, the relay is on a Windows VM, and Jean Jacobs is the single super admin — so the integration is built with GET-only safety, idempotency keys on every write, dry-run gates, and a backup admin designation. Most answers in this form are already filled in from your three scoping calls with Raghuram, Marius, and Venkat. Your job is to confirm what we heard correctly and fill in the blanks we genuinely couldn't know.

journeyCards.label: Phase 1 — Connected
journeyCards.headline: Lead → quote → contract → job → change order all flow automatically
journeyCards.body: HD Portal leads land in Salesforce automatically (UC1 — currently broken). Salesforce-side corrections to customer and quote data push back to HD Portal (UC2). Signed 299A / 299B / 118 contracts download from HD Portal and attach to the right Salesforce records (UC3). New HD orders create Customer + Job records in ComputerEase via the CE Live Service relay, with idempotency keys and dry-run gates on every write (UC4). Multi-system mismatch detection runs in real time across HD + Salesforce + Deltek + ComputerEase and only flags material discrepancies (UC5). Promotion SKU + discount allocation get validated against the signed contract before margin is lost (UC6). The 3-day right-of-rescission date is auto-calculated with state-holiday awareness, and signature legibility is scored on every contract (UC7). Change Order PDFs from Email / Drive flow through Anypoint IDP and land on the matching Salesforce project (UC8). The sync runs automatically and retries on failure — Ashley stops being the human reconciliation engine.

journeyCards.label: Phase 2 — Automated
journeyCards.headline: Validation and compliance checks run themselves
journeyCards.body: Deposit/payment status syncs bidirectionally between HD Portal and Salesforce so Ashley stops re-entering deposit-paid status by hand (UC9). Material-routing tasks (aluminum / PVC → Barb) auto-create in ComputerEase once Peerless documents the routing rules in writing (UC10). Atomic job-number reservation in ComputerEase eliminates the shared spreadsheet (UC11). The same MuleSoft architecture absorbs the GCP-hosted-CE → Deltek-cloud-CE migration when Peerless is ready, taking $5K/month of hosting cost off the table with no flow changes.

journeyCards.label: Phase 3 — Agentic
journeyCards.headline: AgentForce sits on the unified Peerless data — opt-in when you're ready
journeyCards.body: Because Phase 1 lands HD orders, contracts, change orders, and CE job costs on standard Salesforce objects (Opportunity, Quote, QuoteLineItem, Contract, Project, Sales Order), AgentForce can review every new 299A/299B against historical contracts and flag scope/material drift before the job ships to ops; watch Change Order PDFs through IDP and answer 'which jobs lost margin to unapproved field changes this month?'; and compare quoted vs actual material usage (cedar/aluminum/PVC) across all three systems to surface the discount mismatches that don't match the contract. When you're ready, the data is already there — the Phase 1 architecture is what AgentForce reads.

Provide 30+ sample 299A, 299B, 118 contract PDFs and 30+ sample Change Order PDFs (redacted of PII if needed) for IDP model training during the IDP Workshop. sections.title: USE CASES
sections.bodyHtml:
1.1 UC1 — HD Portal Lead → Salesforce Lead (scheduled poll, ~10 min lag) [MEDIUM]

Business problem this solves: Ashley described it directly — "When we create a lead inside of Home Depot Service Center, it doesn't come through inside of Salesforce. So that part needs to be fixed." Today HD Portal leads have to be retyped into Salesforce by hand, costing the ops team an hour a day in reconciliation. On go-live day that stops.

Trigger: Scheduler polling the HD Portal lead-list endpoint every ~10 minutes (HD's downstream propagation floor was 30 min, reduced to 10 min per Marcos). Webhook NOT confirmed available — polling is the path.

Q1.1 [TRIGGERED BY: scheduled] What is the lookback window for each poll — last 15 minutes or longer to allow for HD propagation jitter? Evidence suggests: 15 minutes overlap + idempotency key on F-number (HD lead identifier). Confirm or correct.
Answer (pre-filled — confirm or correct): Inferred from industry pattern. 15-min lookback with idempotency on HD F-number is DataSkate default for ~10-min propagation floors.

Q1.2 [SYSTEM: HD Portal] Confirm DataSkate's read-only HD Portal UI login is now provisioned (originally requested Apr 14, pending Apr 17 — Ashley offered her own login as fallback). Marius is engaged for "another 15 days" from Apr 17 — must resolve while he's still on the engagement.
Answer: Pending as of Apr 17 — Ashley to follow up with HD before May 2. Provide username + temporary password handoff path.

Q1.3 Which Salesforce object should the HD lead land on — Standard Lead, or directly as an Opportunity? Evidence suggests: standard Lead object first, then converted to Opportunity when status reaches "Quoted" — DataSkate default. Cora Barahi (SF admin) to confirm.
Answer: Inferred — confirm with Cora Barahi.

Scope Boundary for this flow:
✅ IN SCOPE: Poll HD Portal lead-list endpoint every ~10 min; upsert into Salesforce Lead keyed by HD_Portal_Id__c (the F-number); set Lead.Source = "Home Depot"; idempotent on F-number.
⚠️ ASSUMED PRE-EXISTS: HD Portal API key (Apr 15 — typed into secrets manager); HD lead-list GET endpoint returns 200 (Venkat confirmed Apr 17); Salesforce sandbox user; HD_Portal_Id__c External ID — created by DataSkate.
❌ OUT OF SCOPE: HD-side lead routing logic, HD lead qualification workflow, push/webhook delivery from HD.

→ See Section 3.2 for pre-filled field mapping.

1.2 UC2 — Salesforce → HD Portal Customer + Quote Correction Write-Back (event-driven) [HIGH]

Business problem this solves: Today the data flow is one-way. Sales reps fix customer info and quote details in Salesforce — phone numbers, addresses, line-item corrections — and HD Portal never sees them. This flow closes the loop: corrections push back to HD Portal automatically.

Trigger: Salesforce CDC on Account / Contact / Quote, OR a Platform Event on a rep-initiated "Sync to HD" button — chosen during architecture review. Streams to MuleSoft → HD Portal write endpoint.

⚠️ P0 BLOCKER: HD Portal write endpoints (POST/PATCH) have NOT yet been confirmed by HD API team. Ashley to escalate to Greg. If they don't exist, UC2 falls back to outbound email or partner-portal screen-scrape — both out of Automation Starter scope. See Q1.4.

Q1.4 [P0] [SYSTEM: HD Portal] Does HD Portal API expose POST/PATCH for customer + quote correction?
Answer: Pending HD API team via Greg. Critical path item — required before architecture sign-off.

Q1.5 Which Salesforce fields trigger the writeback — only "material" customer fields, or every QuoteLineItem too? Evidence suggests from Raghuram FK-034: watch only customer-level fields (Account/Contact) + Quote header + total Amount — NOT every line item edit (would be too chatty).
Answer: Inferred from architect pattern — confirm. Default: Account name/BillingAddress/Phone/Email; Quote.TotalAmount/Quote.Status; QuoteLineItem only when SKU or Quantity changes.

Q1.6 [TRIGGERED BY: event-driven] Immediate or debounced 5-min window? Evidence suggests: debounced 5-min window — DataSkate default for CDC.
Answer: Inferred from DataSkate default — confirm. 5-min debounce.

Scope Boundary for this flow:
✅ IN SCOPE: Salesforce CDC on Account/Quote/QuoteLineItem; 5-min debounce; DWL transform; POST/PATCH to HD Portal write endpoint; idempotent on HD F-number.
⚠️ ASSUMED PRE-EXISTS: HD write endpoints (Q1.4); CDC enabled on Account, Quote, QuoteLineItem; integration user Read+CDC permission.
❌ OUT OF SCOPE: Salesforce validation rule changes; Salesforce trigger/Apex changes; HD Portal UI changes. Fallback paths (outbound email, screen-scrape) are OUT of Automation Starter scope.

→ See Section 3.3 for pre-filled field mapping.

1.3 UC3 — HD Portal Signed Contract (299A/299B) → Salesforce Attachment (scheduled, ~10 min lag) [MEDIUM]

Business problem this solves: Today signed 299A and 299B contracts live only in HD Portal. To find one in Salesforce, ops has to log in to HD Portal, locate the order, download the PDF, then attach by hand. This flow downloads new Final-status contracts and attaches them to the matching Salesforce record automatically.

Trigger: Scheduler polling HD Portal for contracts where status = "Final" (the green/blue button visual cue). Downloads 299A/299B/118 PDFs and attaches to the matching Salesforce Account / Contract.

⚠️ P0 BLOCKER: HD Portal document download endpoint has NOT yet been confirmed. See Q1.7.

Q1.7 [P0] [SYSTEM: HD Portal] Does HD Portal API expose a document download endpoint for 299A/299B/118 PDFs?
Answer: Pending HD API team via Greg.

Q1.8 All three (299A, 299B, 118), or only the legally-binding 299A + 299B? Evidence suggests: all three — 118 (customer-approval form) is part of the compliance package Ashley does manually via DocHub today.
Answer: Inferred from pain-quote — confirm. Default: attach all three.

Q1.9 Salesforce target — Account, Contract, or custom HD_Order__c? Evidence suggests: standard Contract object (Raghuram FK-034 — use Salesforce standard objects).
Answer: Inferred from FK-034 — confirm. Default: standard Contract with ContentDocumentLink to the Account.

Scope Boundary for this flow:
✅ IN SCOPE: Poll HD Portal every ~10 min for Final-status contracts; download 299A/299B/118 via API; create ContentVersion + ContentDocumentLink on the matching Salesforce Contract; idempotent on HD contractId.
⚠️ ASSUMED PRE-EXISTS: HD document download endpoint (Q1.7); Salesforce sandbox user; standard Contract object usable.
❌ OUT OF SCOPE: Document signing workflow (HD Portal); document storage outside Salesforce (no separate S3 archive in Phase 1); OCR / text extraction (that's UC7's job).

→ See Section 3.4 for pre-filled field mapping.

1.4 UC4 — HD Portal + Salesforce → ComputerEase Customer + Job (create on new HD order) [HIGH]

Business problem this solves: Ashley described it on the call — "we have no data points or information of what they've done with this customer, if anything, other than that they created a quote." Today every new HD order means Ashley manually re-keys the customer + job into ComputerEase: financials, commission, overhead, sales-rep initials, and a job number picked from a shared spreadsheet to avoid race conditions. On go-live day that stops.

Trigger: Scheduled poll when HD order reaches "Final" — pulls the order + Salesforce sale data → writes Customer + Job to ComputerEase via the CE Live Service relay (NOT direct VM IP).

⚠️ P0 BLOCKERS bundled here: CE Live Service install (Deltek ticket filed Apr 17, 4-hour SLA); CE production-only API (no sandbox); Jean Jacobs sole admin (backup needed — Brian recommends Laura); GCP firewall + port (likely 443 after install — was 445 SMB).

Q1.10 [P0] [SYSTEM: ComputerEase] Confirm CE Live Service installed and relay URL received from Deltek support.
Answer: Pending Deltek support response.

Q1.11 [P0] [SYSTEM: ComputerEase] Confirm the backup CE admin (Laura recommended). Kirk approval needed. Two-day onboarding delay from Jean's unavailability is the explicit risk this resolves (FK-031).
Answer: Pending Kirk approval. Default: Laura.

Q1.12 CE job-number format {YY}{HD}{seq}{rep-initials} e.g. 26HD565AS. Atomic next-number endpoint in CE, or MuleSoft owns the counter (Object Store, per-department key)?
Answer: Architect decision — confirm with Jean Jacobs. Default: MuleSoft owns the counter in Anypoint Object Store, keyed by {YY}{department}{sales-rep-initials}, locked per request. See Internal Flag #6.

Q1.13 Department codes / customer-type codes / sales-rep-initials mapping documents — Jean Jacobs to deliver before M1.
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: Jean Jacobs to produce.

Scope Boundary for this flow:
✅ IN SCOPE: HD-order-Final trigger; enrich with Salesforce sale data; write Customer + Job to ComputerEase via CE Live Service relay; idempotency keys on every write; dry-run mode gated by ENV property; comprehensive payload logging.
⚠️ ASSUMED PRE-EXISTS: CE Live Service installed (Q1.10); CE API access groups (jobs, subcontracts, cost types, job totals — payroll EXCLUDED); API user provisioned by Jean Jacobs via pwmaint; backup admin designated (Q1.11); code mapping documents (Q1.13).
❌ OUT OF SCOPE: ComputerEase configuration (GL, chart of accounts, job-cost code structure, overhead rules); CE Live Service installation (Deltek's responsibility); CE user provisioning beyond integration user; payroll integration (explicitly excluded).

→ See Section 3.5 for pre-filled field mapping.

1.5 UC5 — Multi-System Validation: Customer + Materials + Pricing Mismatch Detection (api-aggregation) [HIGH]

Business problem this solves: Today Ashley reconciles by hand across four systems and catches mismatches only after they hit a margin issue. This flow runs the reconciliation automatically the moment the HD order is Final and only escalates material discrepancies.

Trigger: Triggered on HD-order-Final — aggregates data from HD + Salesforce + Deltek (pending Q1.14) + CE, compares validation fields, flags material discrepancies.

⚠️ P0 BLOCKER: Is "Deltek" a distinct product (Costpoint, Vantagepoint) or vendor-name overlap with ComputerEase? UC5 sizing changes either way. See Q1.14.

Q1.14 [P0] [SYSTEM: Deltek] Separate Deltek product or vendor-name shorthand for ComputerEase?
Answer: Pending Peerless leadership (Jeff Kelly / Brian Cook). If separate: scope-change discussion required, separate connector + playbook + admin. If overlap: UC5 reduces to three-system validation.

Q1.15 What counts as "material" discrepancy? Evidence suggests: name (any non-whitespace diff), material type (cedar / aluminum / PVC / picket — any change), pricing > $50 OR > 2%.
Answer: Inferred from operational practice — confirm with Ashley.

Q1.16 Where do flagged mismatches land — Salesforce Quote list view with status field, or new Mismatch__c object? Evidence suggests: Quote list view with status field — DataSkate default.
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: Reconciliation_Status__c picklist [Match / Mismatch-Customer / Mismatch-Material / Mismatch-Pricing / Resolved].

Scope Boundary for this flow:
✅ IN SCOPE: On HD-order-Final, fetch matching records from HD + Salesforce + CE (and Deltek if Q1.14 confirms); compare validation fields; write Reconciliation_Status__c on Quote; Chatter message to assigned rep on mismatch.
⚠️ ASSUMED PRE-EXISTS: All UC1–UC4 sources reachable; CE Live Service live; Deltek scope resolved (Q1.14); Reconciliation_Status__c picklist — created by DataSkate.
❌ OUT OF SCOPE: Auto-correction (Ashley resolves); historical reconciliation (Phase 2); ML tolerance bands (Phase 3).

→ See Section 3.6 for pre-filled field mapping.

1.6 UC6 — Promotion SKU + Discount Allocation Validation (event-driven) [MEDIUM]

Business problem this solves: Reps occasionally misapply discounts at the line level. Promotion SKU on HD doesn't match discount allocation on Salesforce Quote, contract reflects wrong allocation, margin is lost. This flow validates promotion SKU + discount allocation against the signed contract — flags margin-impacting mismatches before they hit the contract.

Trigger: Real-time validation at contract creation (same Final-status event as UC3 + UC4).

Q1.17 Validation rule? Evidence suggests: HD promo code (in SKU prefix) == Salesforce Quote DiscountType AND discount % matches signed contract.
Answer: Inferred from HD Portal quirk — confirm.

Q1.18 Block contract creation, or alert only? Evidence suggests: alert only — flag + Chatter to rep + Jeff Kelly. Blocking is too aggressive for Phase 1.
Answer: Inferred from operational-pragmatist profile — confirm.

Q1.19 Confirm Jeff Kelly is ops escalation contact for SKU/discount mismatches.
Answer: Inferred from sage.json — confirm name + email.

Scope Boundary for this flow:
✅ IN SCOPE: On Final-status contract, run validation rule (HD SKU + Salesforce Quote + IDP-extracted contract discount %); write Promo_Discount_Status__c on Quote; Chatter to rep + Jeff Kelly on mismatch.
⚠️ ASSUMED PRE-EXISTS: UC3 has attached contract PDF; UC7 IDP has extracted discount %; Promo_Discount_Status__c picklist on Quote.
❌ OUT OF SCOPE: Auto-correction (humans resolve); historical promo audit (Phase 2); AI-driven discount recommendation (Phase 3).

→ See Section 3.7 for pre-filled field mapping.

1.7 UC7 — Contract Compliance Validation: Right-of-Rescission + Signature/Legibility (event-driven) [HIGH]

Business problem this solves: Federal and state law gives the customer 3 business days to rescind a fence contract (federal + state-holiday aware). Customer signatures must be present and legible — "declined" or "unavailable" breaks the contract. Today Ashley checks compliance by hand on every signed 299A/299B. This flow runs that check automatically.

Trigger: Final-status contract → compute 3-business-day rescission date → IDP signature legibility score → write compliance status back to Salesforce Contract.

Q1.20 State-holiday handling — federal universal; state-only (e.g. Lincoln's Birthday in IL) count toward 3-business-day count? Evidence suggests: yes for IL/IN/OH/WI where Peerless operates.
Answer: Inferred — confirm with Peerless legal. Default: federal + state holidays for IL/IN/OH/WI. Refresh annually.

Q1.21 [TRIGGERED BY: AI/LLM] Signature legibility threshold? Evidence suggests per FK-040: overall ≥ 85% AND every critical field ≥ 80%. Anything below → review queue.
Answer: Inferred from FK-040 — confirm.

Q1.22 Reject list for signer-role: Evidence suggests from rex.json HD Portal quirks: ["declined", "unavailable", "n/a", "none", null, ""]. Must be owner / occupant / owner+occupant.
Answer: Inferred — confirm.

Q1.23 [SYSTEM: Anypoint IDP] State deposit rule check (IL/IN/OH = 100%, WI = 99%) as compliance gate alongside rescission? Evidence suggests: yes — same flow, both HD Portal quirks. Cheap to add.
Answer: Inferred — confirm.

Scope Boundary for this flow:
✅ IN SCOPE: On Final-status contract, compute rescission date (DataWeave business-day fn + IL/IN/OH/WI holiday calendar refreshed annually); submit contract PDF to IDP for signature legibility; check deposit % matches state rule; write Compliance_Status__c on Contract; Chatter to rep + ops manager on fail.
⚠️ ASSUMED PRE-EXISTS: UC3 attached the contract PDF; Anypoint IDP entitlement (UC8); compliance field set defined in IDP Workshop; Compliance_Status__c picklist on Contract.
❌ OUT OF SCOPE: Legal interpretation of right-of-rescission (Peerless legal owns); LLM-based free-form clause extraction; auto-rejection of contracts.

→ See Section 3.8 for pre-filled field mapping.

1.8 UC8 — Change Order PDF → Anypoint IDP → Salesforce Update (hybrid) [HIGH]

Business problem this solves: Change Orders arrive as PDF attachments — sometimes by email, sometimes via Google Drive — and Ashley manually re-keys the changes into the matching Salesforce project/contract. This flow polls both sources for new PDFs, extracts change-order fields with Anypoint IDP, and updates the matching Salesforce record automatically.

Trigger: Scheduler polls (a) IMAP folder for new emails with PDF attachments AND/OR (b) Google Drive folder for new PDFs → POST attachment to Anypoint IDP → poll for SUCCEEDED → DWL transform → update matching Salesforce Project / Contract.

⚠️ P0 BLOCKERS: Source binding (Q1.24) — if BOTH Email AND Google Drive, NO-COMBINE splits UC8 into two flows (count: 8 → 9, pricing re-issued). Anypoint IDP entitlement (Q1.26). Sample documents (Q1.27).

Q1.24 [P0] [SYSTEM: Email/Google Drive] Email only, Drive only, or BOTH?
Answer: Pending Peerless confirmation. If both, flow count rises and pricing is re-issued.

Q1.25 [SYSTEM: Email] Tenant — Microsoft 365 (Graph OAuth), Google Workspace (Gmail API), or other IMAP?
Answer: Inferred from peerlessfence.com email domain — confirm. Likely M365 based on domain pattern.

Q1.26 [P0] [SYSTEM: Anypoint IDP] Anypoint IDP entitlement on Peerless's MuleSoft subscription?
Answer: Pending MuleSoft contract review. If not licensed, P0 scope item.

Q1.27 Sample 299A/299B/118 + Change Order PDFs — who provides, when? Evidence suggests: Ashley (owns the re-keying today). Target: 2 weeks before M1.
Answer: Inferred — confirm with Ashley.

Q1.28 Low-confidence IDP routing rule? Evidence suggests per FK-040: overall ≥ 85% AND every critical field ≥ 80% → auto-update; below → review queue. Critical-field list defined in IDP Workshop.
Answer: Inferred — confirm.

Q1.29 Original email/Drive file after IDP processing — leave, move to processed/, or delete? Evidence suggests: move to processed/ — DataSkate default.
Answer: Inferred — confirm.

Scope Boundary for this flow:
✅ IN SCOPE: Poll Email + Drive sources; stream attachments in-memory to IDP (CloudHub 2.0 filesystem is ephemeral — NEVER write to local disk); poll IDP every ≥ 10s; confidence-route high → Salesforce update, low → review queue; idempotent on email messageId + IDP executionId.
⚠️ ASSUMED PRE-EXISTS: IDP entitlement (Q1.26); IDP action published + trained on Peerless samples (Q1.27); Email OAuth (Graph or Gmail); Drive service account (preferred); specific mailbox/folder IDs.
❌ OUT OF SCOPE: IDP model training (billable separately in IDP Workshop); custom review-queue UI (Phase 1 uses Salesforce list view); SPF/DKIM/DMARC on Peerless sending domain; outbound confirmation reply.

→ See Section 3.9 for pre-filled field mapping.

POTENTIAL FLOWS — Phase 2 candidates (logged so they don't get lost)

UC9 — Bidirectional Payment / Deposit Status Sync (HD ↔ SF) [Priority: High] — Ashley named it: "if that could integrate and flow back through an API, that would be awesome." Today she manually enters deposit-paid status by going through Home Depot reporting. Phase 2 inclusion?

UC10 — CE Task Assignment for Material Routing (Salesforce → CE) [Priority: Medium] — Ashley demonstrated creating CE tasks for Barb on aluminum/PVC orders. Conditional routing rules exist. Client deferred — "Leave the tasking to last in the build out." Phase 2 inclusion + Peerless to document routing rules.

UC11 — Atomic Job-Number Reservation [Priority: Medium] — Job numbers picked manually from a shared spreadsheet to avoid race conditions. Phase 1 or Phase 2? Does CE expose atomic next-number, or does MuleSoft own the counter (Object Store, per-department key — currently the UC4 default)?

sections.title: VOLUME AND PERFORMANCE
sections.bodyHtml:
Q4.1 Expected volume per flow (per hour / day / month)?
Answer (pre-filled — confirm or correct): Inferred from $31.8M ARR + 8-location residential fence contractor — confirm.

  • UC1 (HD lead → SF): ~50–100 leads/day across 8 locations; spring/summer peak.
  • UC2 (SF → HD correction): ~10–30 corrections/day.
  • UC3 (HD contract → SF attachment): ~20–40 signed contracts/day in season.
  • UC4 (HD/SF → CE Customer+Job): ~20–40 new jobs/day.
  • UC5 (multi-system validation): Same volume as UC4.
  • UC6 (Promo SKU validation): Same volume as UC4.
  • UC7 (Compliance validation): Same volume as UC3.
  • UC8 (Change Order PDF intake): ~5–15 PDFs/day off-peak; 15–30/day peak.

Q4.2 Peak load times — annual / monthly / daily?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: spring + summer peak (Apr–Sep); morning ingest spike for IDP (Change Orders arrive overnight); Friday install-date crunch (HD enforces Friday installs).

Q4.3 Maximum acceptable latency per flow?
Answer: Inferred — confirm.

  • UC1, UC3: ≤ 15 min (HD 10-min propagation floor + 5-min poll + processing)
  • UC2: ≤ 10 min (CDC 5-min debounce + processing)
  • UC4: ≤ 15 min after UC3 (CE Live Service relay latency)
  • UC5–UC7: ≤ 30 min (depends on UC3 + UC4)
  • UC8: ≤ 10 min (IDP P50 = 7.6s, P99 = 13.4s)

Q4.4 Uptime SLA?
Answer: Inferred from DataSkate IaaS — confirm. Default: 99.9% (CloudHub 2.0 baseline).

Q4.5 Payload size range?
Answer: Inferred — confirm.

  • UC1–UC2 (lead/quote events): < 50 KB JSON
  • UC3 + UC8 (PDF attachments): 1–10 MB typical (IDP capped at 10 MB / 50 pages)
  • UC4–UC7: < 200 KB JSON per record set

Q4.6 299A/299B/118 + Change Order PDFs typically stay under 50 pages / 10 MB? IDP hard limit.
Answer: Pending — Ashley to confirm with sample PDFs.

Q5.1 Auth method per system — confirm pre-filled.

Q5.2 PII or sensitive data?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: yes — customer name/address/phone/email on UC1–UC5; signature images on UC3 + UC7. Standard residential-contractor data class — not HIPAA / GLBA, but subject to state privacy laws (IL BIPA / IL PIPA).

Q5.3 Regulatory compliance requirements?
Answer: Inferred from IL/IN/OH/WI + residential contracting — confirm. Default: state contractor licensing (sales-rep license number cascade on 299A/299B); federal + state right-of-rescission (UC7); state deposit rules (IL/IN/OH = 100%, WI = 99%); no HIPAA / PCI / GDPR.

Q5.4 Data residency?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: US East CloudHub 2.0; no cross-border.

Q5.5 AWS Secrets Manager for all integration credentials (OAuth tokens, HD API key, CE basic-auth password, Salesforce JWT private key, IDP client secret, Google service account JSON)?
Answer: Inferred from DataSkate IaaS standard — confirm.

Q5.6 Field-level encryption (Salesforce Shield) on specific fields?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: no Shield in Phase 1 (TLS in-transit only); flag for Phase 2 if compliance contract requires it.

Q5.7 mTLS between CloudHub and CE Live Service relay?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: no mTLS Phase 1 (basic auth + IP allowlist on GCP firewall is sufficient perimeter).

Q5.8 Audit trail retention?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: 7 years for compliance records (UC3, UC7); CloudHub logs default 90 days → archive to S3.

sections.title: ERROR HANDLING
sections.bodyHtml:
Q6.1 Target system unavailable — retry / queue / fail?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: 3 retries with exponential backoff (30s → 2min → 5min), then DLQ + alert. ComputerEase on-prem + HD Portal most likely candidates for transient unavailability.

Q6.2 Message expiry in retry queue?
Answer: Inferred — confirm.

  • Critical (UC4 CE writes, UC7 compliance): 7 days TTL
  • Standard (UC1, UC3, UC8): 24 hours TTL
  • Notification (UC5/UC6 alerts): 1 hour TTL

Q6.3 Failure notification recipients + channel?
Answer: Inferred from sage.json namedContacts — confirm + provide emails.

  • Tier 1 — system/integration failures: Brian Cook (Peerless IT) + Raghuram Potluri (DataSkate). Channel: email.
  • Tier 2 — business/process failures (UC5/UC6/UC7 flags, UC8 low-confidence IDP): Ashley Salerno + Jeff Kelly. Channel: email + Salesforce Chatter on the record.

Q6.4 Zero data-loss or best-effort?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: zero data-loss on UC2, UC3, UC4, UC7. Best-effort acceptable on UC5/UC6 alerts.

Q6.5 Idempotency requirement?
Answer: Inferred from CE-production-only constraint — confirm. Default: yes, mandatory on every flow. Keys: HD F-number (UC1), Account.Id (UC2), contractId (UC3), Opportunity.Id (UC4), email messageId + IDP executionId (UC8).

Q6.6 Rollback for financial / provisioning / compliance flows?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: no rollback Phase 1. UC4 — if CE write fails after Salesforce reads, no compensating action needed (CE is the only mutation). Human resolution path (Ashley cancels in CE) — NOT a MuleSoft saga.

Q6.7 IDP MANUAL_VALIDATION_REQUIRED / PARTIAL_SUCCESS — always route to review queue?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: always route with partial extraction visible + human-review flag.

Q9.1 Test environments per system?
Answer: Inferred — confirm.

  • Salesforce sandbox: yes (Cora Barahi in flight)
  • ComputerEase: NO sandbox — production-only API; GET-only safe mode during dev; UAT writes against production with dry-run gates

Q9.2 Automated testing capability at Peerless?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: none; DataSkate provides MUnit suite as the automated test layer; Peerless participates as UAT.

Q9.3 UAT acceptance criteria for 8 confirmed flows?
Answer: Inferred — confirm or adjust.

  • UC1: 5 test HD leads → 5 Salesforce Leads within 15 min, all External IDs correct, 0 duplicates on rerun.
  • UC2 (pending Q1.4): 5 SF Account/Quote edits → 5 HD Portal write-backs within 10 min.
  • UC3 (pending Q1.7): 5 contracts Final → 299A + 299B + 118 PDFs attach within 15 min.
  • UC4: 5 HD orders → 5 CE Customer + Job records, idempotency keys present, dry-run validated, no duplicates, job numbers atomic.
  • UC5: 5 test orders with planted mismatches (1 name diff, 1 material diff, 1 pricing diff > 2%, 2 matching) → 3 flags + 2 matches.
  • UC6: 5 test contracts with planted SKU/discount mismatches (3 mismatches, 2 matches) → Chatter alerts.
  • UC7: 5 contracts (3 IL/IN/OH @ 100% deposit + 2 WI @ 99%, 1 illegible signature, 1 "declined" signer-role) → rescission dates correct, 2 flagged.
  • UC8: 10 PDFs to Email + 10 to Drive → IDP within 2 min; 16/20 high-confidence to SF update, 4/20 to review queue.
  • Zero duplicates across any flow during 24-hour parallel-run.
  • DLQ shows zero unintended messages after 24 hours of test traffic.
  • MUnit ≥ 80% coverage on Process API + System APIs + IDP submit/poll subflow.

Q9.4 Blackout periods?
Answer: Inferred — confirm. Default: avoid Friday (HD install-date crunch); avoid end-of-month accounting close (Jean unavailable); avoid Apr–Sep peak for structural changes (additive deploys OK).

Pricing currently sized assuming both exist. Bundle Q1.4 + Q1.7 into a single HD ticket via Greg — never burn two tickets where one suffices.

ComputerEase production-only API + sole admin + CE Live Service pending → three blockers collectively put the first 2-week sprint at high schedule risk if Jean Jacobs has any unavailability. Backup admin designation (Q1.11) is mandatory before kickoff.

UC1 trigger is scheduled-sync (poll), NOT real-time — HD Portal has not confirmed webhook availability. Architect must size accordingly. Floor latency is the 10-min HD propagation lag.
FLAG-6 — MEDIUM
UC4 job-number reservation: if CE does NOT expose atomic next-number (Q1.12), MuleSoft owns the counter in Object Store with per-department-key locking. Counter must be department-scoped + sales-rep-aware. Architect decision documented during M1.

UC7 right-of-rescission needs federal-holiday calendar (Mule has no built-in). DataWeave business-day fn with hardcoded federal+state holiday list refreshed annually. State-only holidays (e.g. Lincoln's Birthday in IL) need explicit confirmation from Peerless legal.
FLAG-8 — MEDIUM
UC8 IDP confidence threshold defaults (overall ≥ 85%, critical ≥ 80%) need critical-field list defined per document class during IDP Workshop. Without this, single-threshold falls back with known misfire pattern (FK-040).
FLAG-9 — MEDIUM
GCP firewall SSH/RDP open-to-internet was found at onboarding (Raghuram). Must be locked down before production cutover. NOT a Mule integration blocker but a delivery-quality gate item.
FLAG-10 — MEDIUM
Credential handoff via confidential email (clipboard-blocked) is the real operational pattern in this engagement — Marius shared HD Portal API credentials this way Apr 15. Build secrets-manager handoff into delivery plan. NOT AI OCR — hallucination risk per FK-030.

Existing Salesforce integration was originally built by "Amarius" (HD-side dev) — provided HD Portal lead-pull in the original build. DataSkate is replacing/extending, NOT greenfield. Confirm what exists before re-implementing UC1 to avoid double-build (FK-055).
